subject: Mutual Action Plan: convergence on hosting mode & region decision
messages:
From: Sam Patel <sam@acmehealth.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 28 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP template + timeline request for hosting/region decision

Rachel — thanks again for the demo earlier. The exec team liked the latency/cost breakdown you showed. We agreed internally that the next step is a short MAP so we can lock hosting mode (hosted vs dedicated vs private) and target region(s) for our PoC/phase 1.

Can you share a draft MAP with milestones, what's required from our side, and suggested evaluation windows? I attached our Acme MAP template (Acme_MAP_template.xlsx) to show how we normally track dependencies (security sign-off, procurement, infra validation).

High-level asks from us:
- Clear gating criteria on latency and per-token cost for hosted vs dedicated
- Ops requirements for private/VPC option (networking windows, KMS integration)
- Recommended region for lowest latency from our east-coast users (we assume us-east or us-west)

Goal: decide hosting mode and region by 5/31 so we can schedule legal/procurement work next week. Is that viable?

Thanks — Sam
Sam Patel
Head of Engineering, Acme Health
Sam.patel@acmehealth.com
(415) 555-0192

Attachment: Acme_MAP_template.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
To: Sam Patel <sam@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 28 May 2027 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP template + timeline request for hosting/region decision

Sam — great to hear the execs liked the demo. I pulled together a compact MAP and an evaluation checklist (attached: Redwood_MAP_v1.xlsx). Below is a concise plan we recommend to hit your 5/31 decision target while keeping the PoC runway clean.

Summary (recommended path):
- Short evaluation (3 business days): Redwood-hosted vs Redwood-dedicated perf/cost run using a 1k-user synthetic workload. If customer needs strict data residency or air-gapped controls, we include Redwood Private as a parallel track (longer lead time).
- Region: Recommend us-west for initial PoC (lower median latency for your west-coast pilot group). If data residency mandates EU, we can mirror to eu-west later — that will add ~2 weeks for compliance and infra provisioning.

MAP milestones (high level):
1) 5/28 — MAP kickoff / agree criteria (this thread)
2) 5/29–5/31 — Technical eval window (hosted + dedicated quick runs; private feasibility call)
3) 6/1 — Decision locked: hosting mode + primary region (target date if procurement alignment shifts)
4) 6/2–6/9 — Procurement & SLA paperwork (DocuSign & SOC2 evidence)

Decision criteria (examples to include in MAP):
- Latency: p50 / p95 targets for your interactive flows; if hosted meets p95 < 250ms with expected load, prefer hosted for speed to ship.
- Cost: projected monthly token costs at expected QPS; dedicated if long-term volume > X reduces unit costs by >20%.
- Security/Compliance: private required if business unit needs customer-managed keys or physical isolation.

What Redwood will deliver this week:
- Redwood_MAP_v1.xlsx (attached) with the evaluation checklist, telemetry hooks, and prefabricated Grafana dashboard links.
- Reserved time slots for benchmarking: 5/29 10:00–13:00 PT (hosted perf) and 5/30 09:00–12:00 PT (dedicated simulation).
- SOC2 summary, audit evidence guide for procurement (will share if procurement asks).

Requests from Acme:
- Confirm two engineers for the bench runs (names + emails) and provide a sample prompt set (or allow Redwood to use anonymized prompts).
- Confirm whether KMS integration or VPC peering will be required for the PoC (if yes, mark Private as higher priority).

If 5/31 is critical, we can compress the technical eval into a single day with heavier sampling — call out if you prefer that. Otherwise we'll follow the two-window approach to reduce noise.

I'll hold the benchmarking slots noted above. Let me know and I'll send calendar invites and the MAP file with action owners.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Senior Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
rachel_kim@redwood.com
Redwood Inference — Production-first inference for engineers

Attachment: Redwood_MAP_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>

Date: Fri, 28 May 2027 12:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP template + timeline request for hosting/region decision

Rachel / team —

We can cover the dedicated simulation and provide a runbook for the hosted vs dedicated microbench. Confirmed availability: 5/29 10:00–13:00 PT for hosted perf; I'll lead the dedicated simulation on 5/30 09:00–12:00 PT.

If Acme can share the sample prompt set by end of day 5/28, we'll pre-warm KV caches and set sequence length distribution to match your traffic. Also: if Acme expects >1M tokens/day during PoC, flag that — dedicated economics will look different and we should present both blended and committed pricing.

On quoting the previous MAP notes:
> Decision criteria (examples to include in MAP):
> - Latency: p50 / p95 targets for your interactive flows; if hosted meets p95 < 250ms with expected load, prefer hosted for speed to ship.

Agree with that threshold as a practical guide.

Karthik

Rachel / team — thanks for the clear plan and the attachment. Procurement reviewed the MAP template and we can target a hosted-first PoC if the p95 latency target is met in your 5/29 run. We still need to validate SOC2 artifacts for procurement (they requested the report and the last 12 months of incident summary).

Next steps: 
- Confirmed: 5/29 hosted perf run (Sam Patel, Priya Shah as engineers).
- Confirmed: 5/30 dedicated simulation (optional, we'll join first hour).
- Procurement: I'll route the SOC2 request — expect an email to your security alias shortly.
- Legal: we prefer to run a short SOW/statement that covers PoC scope. I attached a draft SOW (Acme_SOW_draft.pdf) with a few redlines around data retention. Can you have Sales Ops / Legal point of contact to take ownership?

Assuming the hosted run looks good, we'll lock hosting mode + primary region by 5/31 and get the procurement DocuSign started on 6/1. If private is required later, we'll scope that as a Phase 2.

Sam
Sam Patel
Head of Engineering, Acme Health
